actions.message: Great job on your strong contributions! Keep it up.

answer.explanation: Resident4 has contributed less than 10% of the endowment for two consecutive rounds, triggering the punishment rule. A private praise is sent to Resident6 for their high contributions.

Round11 0, round12 0 => two consecutive rounds <10, so punish Resident4. Use amount 10 per constitution. Cost 3 (punishment_cost 0.3 *10). We have wallet plenty. Also can praise high contributors: who contributed >=60% of their wallet this round? We are doing contribution now, but praising another. Choose Resident6 as high contributor historically. So actions: contribute 1709.104 and punish Resident4 amount 10, and also maybe a private message praising? Only one communication allowed. We can choose private_message instead of broadcast. Choose private_message to Resident6 praising. That's allowed one communication. So we have two actions: contribute and private_message, plus punish would be third - not allowed. Max 2 actions total. Need choose at most one physical and one communication. Punish is physical. So we must pick either contribute or punish, plus a communication. Constitution says punish free-riders. Should prioritize punish. So choose punish as physical, and private_message as communication. No contribution this round, but constitution also says Conserve Resources if wallet below 30% not the case. Baseline contribution is mandated unless rest? It says baseline 80% contribution unless conserve. But we can rest? Not mandated to rest. But we can choose punish instead of contribute? The rules didn't forbid both, but max 2 actions, could we do both contribute and punish? That would be 2 physical actions, not allowed (max one physical). So need choose either contribute or punish. Constitution prioritizes punish free-riders. I'd choose punish Resident4 amount10, and also broadcast? No broadcast round. So private_message praising Resident6. Provide explanation.
